feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 2 June 2026 6:43am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 02 June 2026 at 5:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Complex areas of low pressure to the west of the British Isles as various frontal zones affect the area.


##Wind##

Mainly west or southwest 2 to 4, but variable 3 or less in places, increasing mainly 4 or 5 this evening, before backing south or southwest overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Mist and fog patches with occasional outbreaks of rain this morning, clearing to mainly fair but with a few showers early afternoon.


##Visibility##

Poor in mist and very poor in fog patches, otherwise moderate to good, becoming mostly good, occasionally moderate in showers this afternoon.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4, occasionally 5, backing south or southeast 4 to 6 on Wednesday morning, veering southwest Wednesday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Rain soon arriving Wednesday morning, clearing to scattered showers in the afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or showers.
